## Change

Describe the problem and the smallest implemented change.

## Analytical impact

- [ ] No analytical output changes
- [ ] Data/feature change
- [ ] Model/score/optimizer change
- [ ] Generated artifacts updated and metric differences explained

## Verification

- [ ] Ruff format/check
- [ ] Tests and ≥90% coverage
- [ ] Data-quality/artifact verification
- [ ] Security checks
- [ ] Documentation/model card/ADR updated when required

## Decision-support safety

Confirm that no personal data, real confidential commercial data or investment claim
was introduced.
